verdict.rationale: Docs confirm you can export in open Markdown format (or Any-Block) at any time, and export/import full channels when switching network identity, giving users a documented path to take their data elsewhere; local storage and self-host/local-only modes reinforce non-lock-in. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that exports are lossless across all object types (databases, relations, etc.) and no community report validating a full 'export and leave' migration.
